dataset.title: Data from: Effects of genotype on rates of substitution during experimental evolution

inspection.method: official Dryad API metadata plus rendered previews of the three tabular files

reason: Each evolved population contributes one endpoint MIC. The candidate history is a founding resistance genotype, not the frozen downstream C/N treatment history used by the D'Onofrio prediction. Endpoint fitness and mutation summaries are outcomes or mediators measured after evolution, so treating them as present-state covariates would change the construct and risk post-treatment adjustment. GroupKFold by population would also have one outcome row per group and would not reproduce the repeated-measure prediction design.
next_route: Use the already frozen LTEE new-MIC route or another dataset with repeated endpoint outcomes, a pre-outcome history label and state variables measured independently of that history and outcome.
download_note: Dryad exposed public metadata and previews, but automated file endpoints returned an anti-bot validation page during this run. No HTML challenge response is stored or represented as source data.
